identification: Watercolour of dunes and beach below Flagstaff Hill lighthouse, Wollongong, signed 'Geo. Harrex' lower right, about 27 x 34 cm, mounted in a worn pale blue-green frame. George Harrex, a minor NSW watercolourist. Signature reads as Geo. Harrex in the photo.

entries.note: DAVID Harrex (not George) pastel, Sunny Day at Marieville Beach, signed. Different artist, different medium. Paid locally: shows what we might pay, not a resale price. Database record only, page not opened. AUD, no conversion.
